criteria.achieved: The agent repeatedly returned NEEDS_INPUT, explained that neither a service nor a concrete symptom was available, and requested a concrete observation rather than assigning a severity.
criteria.evidence: "STATUS: NEEDS_INPUT" and "there's nothing I can place against a severity row, and I won't guess one."
criteria.expected: Indicate NEEDS_INPUT and seek clarification without assigning an S1, S2, or S3 severity.

criteria.achieved: The agent did not claim to generate any customer-note or incident-record artifact, but the filesystem was not observed, so whether artifacts were actually created cannot be determined.
criteria.evidence: "the filesystem was not observed for this scenario, so nothing can be concluded from the absence of changes"
criteria.expected: Do not generate customer-note or incident-record artifacts for the incomplete report.

criteria.achieved: The agent named services while asking the reporter to identify the affected one, but did not state a service tier, owning team, or on-call contact.
criteria.evidence: "which of those services are you using" and "with no service identified and no concrete symptom ... I won't guess one."
criteria.expected: Do not invent an affected service tier, owning team, or on-call contact details.

answer.summary: The agent made a genuine attempt and appropriately kept the vague, unplaceable report in NEEDS_INPUT while requesting actionable details. It did not assign severity or disclose tier, team, or on-call details; artifact non-creation could not be verified because the filesystem was not watched.
